name: hash-baseline
title: What the template hashes can and cannot say
description: Measured: of 181 tracked files, 34 differ from their recorded hash and 74 are absent - and the classification is tool updates, generated bytecode and gitignored runtime state, with AGENTS.md the only file this repository edited on purpose. The hash file is an init-time baseline, not a tamper flag, and the check that reads it should say so
